parameters.query:
SELECT
    b.id AS booking_id,
    b.passenger_id,
    b.flight_id,
    b.seat_class,
    b.status,

    p.full_name,
    p.email,

    f.flight_number,
    f.origin,
    f.destination,
    f.departure_ts,
    f.arrival_ts,

    CASE f.origin
        WHEN 'LHR' THEN 'Europe/London'
        WHEN 'DXB' THEN 'Asia/Dubai'
        WHEN 'KHI' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
        WHEN 'LHE' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
        WHEN 'ISB' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
        ELSE 'UTC'
    END AS origin_timezone,

    CASE f.destination
        WHEN 'LHR' THEN 'Europe/London'
        WHEN 'DXB' THEN 'Asia/Dubai'
        WHEN 'KHI' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
        WHEN 'LHE' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
        WHEN 'ISB' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
        ELSE 'UTC'
    END AS destination_timezone,

    to_char(
        f.departure_ts AT TIME ZONE
        CASE f.origin
            WHEN 'LHR' THEN 'Europe/London'
            WHEN 'DXB' THEN 'Asia/Dubai'
            WHEN 'KHI' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
            WHEN 'LHE' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
            WHEN 'ISB' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
            ELSE 'UTC'
        END,
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS departure_local_time,

    to_char(
        f.arrival_ts AT TIME ZONE
        CASE f.destination
            WHEN 'LHR' THEN 'Europe/London'
            WHEN 'DXB' THEN 'Asia/Dubai'
            WHEN 'KHI' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
            WHEN 'LHE' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
            WHEN 'ISB' THEN 'Asia/Karachi'
            ELSE 'UTC'
        END,
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS arrival_local_time

FROM bookings b

JOIN passengers p
    ON p.id = b.passenger_id

JOIN flights f
    ON f.id = b.flight_id

WHERE b.status = 'confirmed'
  AND b.reminder_sent = false
  AND f.status = 'scheduled'
  AND f.departure_ts > NOW()
  AND f.departure_ts <= NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'

ORDER BY f.departure_ts ASC;
